summary: ITER148 Sprint C · /relations/* lead/prospect/account stages tested end-to-end. Backend 12/12 PASS (stats, list endpoints, filters, promotion lifecycle, designers, welcome payload). Frontend partially passes: leads page renders 40 cards, prospects 4 lanes, accounts 37 cards, stage-nav with 3 pills works and accent colors distinct (slate/teal/gold). TWO CRITICAL FRONTEND BUGS: (1) clicking a lead card opens the 'Profilo Personale — Presentati ai tuoi clienti' onboarding modal instead of the Welcome Drawer (the profile completion gate intercepts the card click for the demo user); (2) DesignerChip is absent from the footer of every lead card (data-testid 'designer-chip-*' count = 0 on /relations/leads — chips ARE present on prospect lanes). ONE STATS DISCREPANCY: the stage-nav shows '0 Accounts' under /relations/leads even though /relations/accounts renders 37 cards — backend /api/relations/stats correctly returns account>=1 in tests, but the navigation pill count appears to read only from leads.progression_state='account' and not the accounts table (or there is a caching/staleness issue).

minor.issue: next_moments items use field name `kind` (not `code` as stated in the review request). Frontend WelcomeDrawer.jsx:107 also consumes `m.kind`, so the contract is consistent BUT the review request copy says `code` — update doc or rename one of them for clarity.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking any lead card opens the 'Profilo Personale · Presentati ai tuoi clienti' onboarding modal instead of the Welcome Drawer. The profile-completion modal is gating ALL clicks on relation cards for the demo user (Stefano Ogrisek profile is incomplete). User can never reach the Welcome Drawer → Continuation Interview flow until they complete their personal profile. Either suppress the modal during /relations/* testing OR allow the WelcomeDrawer to open above the profile modal.

data-testid 'designer-chip-*' count = 0 on /relations/leads even though every card has a 'STEFANO OGRISEK · FONDATORE · AVAILABLE' footer rendered visually. The chip is missing its data-testid OR a different component is being used on Leads vs Prospects. Prospect lanes correctly render designer-chip-*.

Stage-nav pill on /relations/leads shows '0 Accounts' but /relations/accounts page renders 37 wide cards (confirmed visually and via /api/relations/accounts returning 37+ rows). The nav count is reading only leads.progression_state='account' and not adding the accounts-table count. Backend /api/relations/stats DOES return account>=1 correctly (test_stats_returns_keys passes) — likely the frontend hook reads a different field or there is a stage-nav-specific counter.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise the Continuation Interview drawer because the Welcome Drawer never opens (blocked by profile-completion modal — see UI bug above). Backend POST /api/relationships/intake/answer-event was NOT exercised through the UI as a result.

issues: Slate dot on Leads ✓, teal dot on Prospects ✓, gold dot on Accounts ✓ — three accents visibly distinct on the three pages.
Many i18n missing string warnings (auth.login.*, nav.client_relations_*, nav.runtime.loading, brand.sub) — pre-existing, but the LEAK 0 / MISS 8 dev pill confirms it.
Pre-existing React warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' from LocalizationOverlay/LoginPage and LocalizationOverlay/Sidebar — pre-existing setState-in-render.

verifications.Frontend_prospects_lanes: PASS · 4 prospect lanes (data-testid='prospect-lane-*'), each with DesignerChip + momentum + 'Promote to account' CTA + italic narrative ('arriving at the threshold')
verifications.Frontend_accounts_cards: PASS · 37 account cards (data-testid='account-card-*'), each with monogram, 'Where we are' italic tone line, mood swatches strip, 'conversation open' status
verifications.Frontend_stage_nav: PASS visually (slate/teal/gold accents distinct on 3 pages) · FAIL on Accounts pill count (shows 0 instead of 37)
verifications.Frontend_welcome_drawer: FAIL · clicking lead card opens profile-completion modal instead of WelcomeDrawer
verifications.Frontend_continuation_interview: NOT_EXERCISED · blocked by Welcome Drawer not opening

action_items: FIX FRONTEND (CRITICAL): the profile-completion modal must NOT intercept lead-card clicks. Either suppress when the user is on /relations/* or render the WelcomeDrawer above/independent of the profile gate. Without this, the entire Sprint C interactive surface is unreachable for users with incomplete profiles (including the demo user).

FIX FRONTEND (HIGH): add data-testid='designer-chip-{id}' to the chip rendered in the LeadCard footer (currently missing — only Prospect lanes have it). The footer visually shows the designer, so the chip component is mounted but the testid prop isn't being threaded through.

FIX FRONTEND (HIGH): RelationsStageNav 'Accounts' pill count is 0 while /relations/accounts has 37 cards. Either the hook is reading leads.progression_state='account' only (missing the accounts-table count), or the stats endpoint result is stale. Backend /api/relations/stats does include accounts-table count — verify useRelations.js / RelationsStageNav.jsx is reading the right field.
CLARIFY CONTRACT: welcome next_moments uses `kind` field name; the review request copy says `code`. Pick one and update either the doc or the API.
OPTIONAL: address the noisy i18n missing-key warnings (auth.login.*, nav.client_relations_*, nav.runtime.loading) — pre-existing but it's MISS 8 LEAK 0 on every page.
critical_code_review_comments: Stage navigation visual distinction (slate/teal/gold) is correctly implemented — the editorial brief is respected.
LeadsPage renders 40 cards as required; Prospects lanes structure (Designer identity + Momentum metrics + Narrative + Promote CTA) matches the brief.
AccountsPage wide-card grid with mood swatches + 'Where we are' italic line matches the brief; NO task counters present (compliant).
/api/relations/promote correctly enforces tenant isolation (test_promote_404_for_unknown_id passes) and the transition matrix in client_relations.py:204 is well-defined.

Welcome payload contract is correct (`lead`, `designer`, `next_moments[]`) and items include `kind` matching what the frontend WelcomeDrawer.jsx consumes — only the doc/spec mismatch on `kind` vs `code`.

Frontend gating bug: a global profile-completion modal that intercepts ALL relation-card clicks is a UX dead-end. Card click handlers should check the modal state and either dismiss it first or render the drawer on top.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (3/5 critical surfaces — lists, prospects, accounts render; Welcome Drawer + DesignerChip on leads + stage-nav account count broken)

seed_data_creation: TestPromote::test_promote_lead_to_prospect_and_rollback moves the FIRST lead returned by /api/relations/leads through lead → prospect → account → dormant. The lead is left in 'dormant' state. Re-running the test will pick the next first lead. No new rows created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid (12/12 PASS). The frontend has THREE concrete defects that need E1 fixes: (1) profile-completion modal intercepts lead-card clicks → WelcomeDrawer unreachable, (2) DesignerChip data-testid missing on lead cards, (3) stage-nav Accounts pill shows 0 even though accounts table has 37 rows. After fixes, re-run with the same demo user and verify: clicking a lead card opens [data-testid='welcome-drawer'] with greeting + 'Atmosphere captured' + Cultivated by chip + next_moments action buttons, clicking [data-testid='welcome-drawer-action-continuation_interview'] opens [data-testid='ci-drawer'] with progress bar + italic question + options, clicking [data-testid^='ci-option-'] fires POST /api/relationships/intake/answer-event?tenant_slug=mood-demo-studio-81a09e and advances to next question.
rca of the issue: Welcome Drawer not opening: a global profile-onboarding modal ('Presentati ai tuoi clienti') renders on top of /relations/* and captures clicks before LeadCard's onClick handler can dispatch the drawer-open event. Likely root in App.js or a top-level layout that mounts the profile modal whenever profile.is_complete=false — the modal should be either dismissible or skipped on /relations/* routes. DesignerChip missing testid on Leads: LeadsPage uses a different chip variant (or omits the testid prop) compared to ProspectsPage — search for <DesignerChip ... /> usage in LeadsPage.jsx and confirm the testid prop is passed. Stage-nav Accounts count = 0: useRelations.js stats hook is probably reading the 'account' key from a payload that excludes the accounts-table count, or the RelationsStageNav.jsx is reading a stale count from a different source — verify by GET /api/relations/stats response in browser devtools.
